judged_text: Admin::GroupsController#remove_member looks up the group with `Group.find(params[:id].to_i)` — the line carried over unchanged from the old `destroy` action — but the new member route `delete "members" => "groups#remove_member"` inside `resources :groups` binds the group id as `params[:group_id]`, and both the client (`Discourse.Group#removeMember` requesting `/admin/groups/<id>/members.json`) and the diff's own specs supply `group_id`, never `id`. In every real request `params[:id]` is nil, so `Group.find(0)` raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound and the endpoint returns 404 — the admin UI's remove-member button never removes anyone — and both new specs (`xhr :delete, :remove_member, group_id: group.id, ...` expecting success, and `group_id: 1` expecting 422) fail against this code.
